ce2166f8b162bd76d56aa065898b5d89b82b1377.question: What did the Burning Rate Emulator show about material flammability?
ce2166f8b162bd76d56aa065898b5d89b82b1377.answer: Microgravity flight evidence from the Burning-Rate Emulator (BRE) demonstrated that a gas-fueled burner successfully reproduced solid-material burning behavior using gaseous fuel flames [S1]. Ground-based drop facility tests using pure methane and ethylene showed that microgravity BRE tests revealed bubble-like or nominally hemispherical flames with decelerating growth and quasi-steady heat flux [S5, S6]. The passages do not provide evidence regarding the effect of the BRE on material flammability itself, as the BRE uses a gaseous surrogate rather than a burning solid [S1].
